source_batch.unit_label: BRBL B U07: Creation/Registration and Satisfaction of Charges — Track modifications, acquired charged assets, public records and company recordkeeping

facts.locator: printed pp.218–219; PDF page = printed page + 19
facts.statement: Courseware discusses modification, property acquired subject to charge, Registrar records and the company register at its registered office.

Section 79 applies section 77 so far as may be to the specified acquisition and modification cases. Section 81 covers the Registrar register/inspection with prescribed fees. Section 85 requires the company register and instrument copy at the registered office, with member/creditor and other-person inspection distinctions and stated restrictions.

payload.title: Do not stop tracking after the first charge is registered
payload.core_explanation_md:
A security can change after creation. Section 79 extends section 77 so far as may be to acquisition of property subject to a charge and to the stated modification of terms, extent or operation of a registered charge. Compare the changed transaction with the existing recorded particulars rather than assume the original filing covers every later amendment.

Retain the modification instrument, relevant property facts and required filing/result evidence. A commercial amendment and an administrative correction are also different: correcting a mistaken recorded particular should not be used to disguise an actual new transaction or changed security scope. The exact form and version remain subject to the rules.

self_check.prompt_text: Why should a later security amendment be compared with the registered particulars?
self_check.expected_takeaway: The modification may engage section 79 and the applicable registration process.

payload.title: The Registrar record and the company register are separate
payload.core_explanation_md:
Section 81 concerns the Registrar maintained record and its public inspection on prescribed fees. Section 85 separately requires a company register at the registered office and a copy of the charge instrument there. One record is not automatically a substitute for the other.

Section 85 distinguishes member or creditor inspection without payment from inspection by another person on prescribed fees, subject to the stated reasonable restrictions. Keep access, records and fees tied to the correct provision. Neither inspecting a record nor finding an entry certifies all title, validity or priority questions. Detailed retention periods and current procedural form requirements still need rule-level evidence.

self_check.prompt_text: Does a Registrar entry remove the separate company-register obligation?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. The provisions impose distinct recordkeeping requirements.

payload.stem_md: A company acquires property already subject to a charge and assumes that only newly signed charge instruments can engage section 77. Which provision expands the enquiry?

options.text_md: Section 80 replaces all acquisition and modification enquiries with a valuation
options.explanation_md: The notice rule does not supply that replacement.

options.text_md: Only the old facility number matters to every filing decision
options.explanation_md: Administrative numbering does not determine statutory scope.

options.text_md: Section 79 applies section 77 so far as may be to the specified acquired-property and modification cases
options.explanation_md: The statutory extension makes these facts relevant.

options.text_md: Every acquisition automatically satisfies registration without further evidence
options.explanation_md: An acquisition fact does not establish the required procedure or its result.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The statutory extension makes these facts relevant.

payload.stem_md: A company has a Registrar entry but no separate register or instrument copy at its registered office. Which distinction is being missed?

options.text_md: The company register is identical to the lender internal loan ledger
options.explanation_md: These records serve different purposes and are not interchangeable.

options.text_md: Only the valuation report is needed once any filing exists
options.explanation_md: A valuation does not satisfy the separate company recordkeeping duty.

options.text_md: Section 85 requires a register only after repayment in every case
options.explanation_md: The duty is not stated as arising only after repayment.

options.text_md: Sections 81 and 85 address separate Registrar and company records
options.explanation_md: The company duty is not discharged merely by an entry in the Registrar records.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The company duty is not discharged merely by an entry in the Registrar records.
